column1: # AdaCore SPARK2014 gnatprove testsuite units used as an AdaLang Analyzer
# Columns (tab-separated): test_dir  class  n_src  loc  obligation_kinds
#   class=clean : GNATprove's committed test.out proves every check, so it
#                 is a full oracle here -- any AdaLang definite-error is a
#                 false positive, any AdaLang proved-safe that GNATprove
#                 could not prove is possible unsoundness.
#   class=weak  : test.out carries a deliberate medium/high check of a
#                 scalar kind -- an unsoundness tripwire: AdaLang must never
#                 call proved-safe a location GNATprove reports medium/high.
# Selection is by obligation kind, read from each unit's own sources and its
# committed test.out -- never from how AdaLang scores it. See README.md for
# the full criteria and the scan scripts (select_candidates.py, then
# pick_manifest.py, whose HAND_EXCLUDE set drops units whose baseline is not
# a sound oracle at this toolchain).
